info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v1-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETA Retrieval API enables users to access estimated arrival times for food deliveries. This API provides detailed information about delivery status and expected timings, helping businesses manage customer expectations and improve service efficiency. Typical consumers include food delivery platforms and logistics managers seeking to optimize their operations. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experiences with timely and accurate delivery information.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the estimated delivery time for their packages. By providing the necessary parameters, customers can receive accurate ETAs based on current logistics and travel conditions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries based on the provided input parameters.
